children: Germany's RWE has reported solid results for the first nine months, but any impact might be limited, Citi's Piotr Dzieciolowski says. The energy company posted earnings that came ahead of expectations and said it expects to deliver the upper end of its guidance range for the current year. The beat and outlook improvement are positive but historically the market hasn't paid much attention to surprisingly positive trading results, the analyst writes in a research note. (andrea.figueras@wsj.com)
